acquisition_method.evidence: During the chromatographic separation, the Q Exactive plus was operated in a data-dependent mode and under direct control of the Thermo Excalibur 3.1.66 (Thermo Scientific).
experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Reduced samples were alkylated by adding Iodoacetamide at a final concentration of 10 mM.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Reduced samples were alkylated by adding Iodoacetamide at a final concentration of 10 mM.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Micro s-Trap (Protifi) columns were used for tryptic digestion as per the manufacturer’s instructions.

fragmentation_method.evidence: 20 data-dependent collisional-induced-dissociation (CID) MS/MS scans per full scan (400 to 1800 m/z) at 70,000 resolutions.

instrument.evidence: Samples were injected and measured using a Q exactive Plus high-reslution tandem mass spectrometer.

ionization_type.evidence: An externally calibrated Thermo Q Exactive Plus (high-resolution electrospray tandem mass spectrometer) was used in conjunction with Dionex UltiMate3000 RSLCnano System.

labeling.evidence: EV samples were processed using TMTpro 16 plex labeling kit.
